_help: Add/edit questions. In answers, {ip}, {min} and {max} are replaced from site.json.

faq.a: You can join with any version from {min} to {max}.
Open Minecraft, go to Multiplayer, click Add Server, enter {ip} and join.

faq.q: How do I buy a rank?
faq.a: Check your in-game balance with /coins, open a ticket and tell an admin which rank and how long you want. See the Ranks page for prices and perks.

faq.q: Can I buy a rank with coins from the Discord economy?
faq.a: No. Ranks can only be bought with in-game server coins (/coins), not with coins from the Discord economy system (/balance).

faq.q: What happens if I break the rules?
faq.a: Violations of the rules might result in warnings, kicks, mutes or bans. Rules may change at any time, so check the Rules page regularly.

faq.q: I found a bug. What should I do?
faq.a: Don't abuse it. Report it to staff instead.
